sections.title: **INVESTIGATION:     ULTRASOUND WHOLE ABDOMEN**
sections.text:
**_===============================================================_** 

**Liver:** is normal in size (~13.5cm), outline and showing normal parenchymal echogenicity. No focal lesion is seen. No intrahepatic biliary dilatation seen. Hepatic veins are normal. Portal vein is normal. 

**Gall bladder** : Well distended. No e/o any calculus / mass seen in its lumen **.** No e/o any GB wall thickening or pericholecystic collection. Proximal CBD is normal in caliber. 

**Pancreas:** is normal (head and body) in bulk and echogenicity, tail is obscured due to overlying bowel gases. MPD is not dilated. 

**Spleen:** is normal in size (~8.8cm), outline and echogenicity. No focal lesion seen. 

**Right kidney: is small in size (~6.6 x 3cm),** normal in shape and outline **with increased cortical echogenicity** . **Corticomedullary differentiation is lost** .  No calculus or hydronephrosis is seen. 

**Left kidney:** is normal in size (~9 x 4.8cm), shape and outline with **increased cortical echogenicity** . Corticomedullary differentiation is maintained. No calculus or hydronephrosis is seen. 

**Urinary Bladder:** is partially distended. 

**Prostate:** is normal in size (Vol~18cc), shape and echotexture. 

**A small anterior abdominal wall defect measuring~1.4cm size is seen at umbilical region. Omental fat and small bowel loop is seen herniating. No e/o any bowel wall thickening or sign of strangulation is seen in present scan.** 

Rest of the bowel loops are normal in calibre. 

No lymphadenopathy / free fluid seen.

sections.text:

- **B/L increased renal parenchymal echogenicity S/O CKD.** 

- **<u>Small fat containing umbilical hernia.</u>**
